## Non-negotiable safety and scope
A running Domain App consumes trusted sealed plain-data BUILD output. External BUILD never runs inside Microkernel. K Primary alone owns state/admission/journal/effects/replay/UNKNOWN; Host implements physical CAS, not policy. Optional S features / C operations must be selected explicitly. The only physically qualified v0.10.2 lane is Node24; no OS vendor, 128GB memory, npm registry publication or cross-platform matrix is promised. No future version inherits the v0.10.2 one-release Full exception.

All references above are current-document links; old v0.1/v0.3 SDK references are preserved only as history.
